explanation: Chlorine gas reacts with dry slaked lime to produce bleaching powder — the industrial reaction that turns chlorine from the chlor-alkali process into a usable disinfecting and bleaching agent.

beaker_view.initial_appearance: White, dry slaked lime powder, with chlorine gas passed over it.
beaker_view.final_appearance: Still a white powder — now bleaching powder.
beaker_view.observation: Chlorine gas passed over the dry slaked lime is absorbed into it; there's little visible change beyond the gas disappearing into the white solid.
